scope: Guided saved-observation collection tracker and direct notebook navigation

unit.command: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/titration_collection_tracker.test.js tests/titration_investigation.test.js tests/titration_investigation_report.test.js tests/titration_notebook_removal.test.js tests/titration_immersive_bench.test.js tests/titration_focus_relationships.test.js --pool=forks --no-isolate --maxWorkers=1 --testTimeout=30000

checks: Collection tracker distinguishes saved and live observations, excludes old readings, shows missing sides and wide/narrowing gaps, navigates to exact note fields with keyboard focus, preserves evidence during note edits and setup changes, restores after remount and undo, and keeps 3D viewer identity.

Notebook evidence labels, full-capacity removal, exact undo including notes and guide attribution, paused/other setups, serialized recovery, last removal only, new edits and reused IDs, clear recovery, last row, keyboard focus, plot selection, forced colors and stable 3D viewer pass.
Prediction diagrams: guide disclosure, keyboard range controls, exact scale changes, boundary and off-scale predictions, saved-state isolation, report preview and static exported diagram pass.

Report preview and real download preserve saved evidence and notes; keyboard open/close/Escape, other live setups, free exploration, long and hostile text, Unicode truncation, print control/media, invalidation and remount pass.
Actual additions and shared notebook saves drive all five steps; older notebook data is excluded, notes and practice records persist, and serialized remount restores the completed study.

Keyboard focus, optional hints, invalid predictions, setup pause/restore, free exploration, cleared/full notebooks, revisiting volume, 3D viewer identity, context-loss fallback, and forced colors pass.

limits: Scoped validation rather than the full repository suite.
Forced-color axe scans exclude the contrast rule; other applicable rules and layout/ARIA checks run.
Browser emulation, not a physical-device or classroom pilot.
Changes are local and not deployed.
